gen-audiowide-gf-glegoo: Glegoo has big counters in a tall lowercase, and its curved letters keep wide unclosed mouths. Audiowide skims above on unchanging strokes while the body slows things down.
gen-audiowide-gf-hanuman: Tile-like and futuristic, Audiowide draws plain unshaded lines over Hanuman, a traditional serif with a high-waisted lowercase and wide-set terminals on s. Underneath, the refined body brings old-world polish to the futuristic edge.
gen-audiowide-gf-kadwa: Kadwa reads large and open, its curves all left open-ended. Pages of it would feel classic and editorial, a steady counterweight to Audiowide, whose every glyph keeps a single-width stroke.
gen-audiowide-gf-noticia-text: Audiowide draws horizontals no thinner than its verticals, giving the heading a futuristic, tech-minded look. And Noticia Text, its lowercase filling most of the height, would carry pages in a literary, dignified voice.
gen-audiowide-gf-piazzolla: Smooth as tubing, Audiowide runs tile-like letters over Piazzolla, a text serif whose lowercase nearly matches its capitals. The pried-open e is what keeps all that tubing human.
gen-audiowide-gf-pridi: A single-weight, outline-like line defines Audiowide, set against Pridi, a text serif whose small letters stand proud, almost capital-sized. Tech-edged heading, classic body: that tension is the whole appeal.
gen-audiowide-gf-scope-one: Rope-thin and tile-like, Audiowide hovers over Scope One, a text serif whose counters spill into the space around them. Thin line above, stubby, sturdy lettering below, refined and traditional.
gen-audiowide-gf-slabo-13px: Not a trace of calligraphic modulation shows in Audiowide, whose tile-like glyphs look futuristic. Slabo 13px is bookish and dignified, with clear openings in all its rounded letters.
gen-audiowide-gf-suwannaphum: Suwannaphum has a c as open as a bent paperclip and an x-height reaching high like woodblock type. Beneath the unbroken line of Audiowide, it feels dignified and editorial.
gen-comfortaa-gf-bhutuka-expanded-one: BhuTuka Expanded One reads at a leisurely walk, its curvy letters unclamped and its thin joins no thinner than the stems. Comfortaa adds friendly neon-tube strokes while pages unfold unhurried.
